title: Read Image
text: Extract image from ROS Image message, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Image Encoding} sets Image encoding; {Maximum Image Size}, {Show Alpha output port} sets the toggle AlphaChannel port, {Show ErrorCode output port} sets the toggle ErrorCode port and {Output variable-size signals} sets the toggle variable-size signal output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Msg
ports.summary: ROS sensor_msgs/Image or sensor_msgs/CompressedImage message nonvirtual bus

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Extracted image signal M -by- N -by-3 matrix | M -by- N matrix

ports.name: AlphaChannel
ports.summary: Alpha channel for image M -by- N matrix

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error code for image conversion scalar

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Toggle variable-size signal output off (default) | on
